en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a quiet wooded scene with a few small white houses with tiled roofs nestled among trees. A dirt path and garden or landscaped area lead toward the houses, while tall trees line the right side of the image. Printed captions in Dutch and German at the bottom mention the area near Nijmegen (Berg en Dal) and a Salvation Army colony house.
